name: Annotator JSON Export
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: In the preview, clear the checkbox of a row to leave that annotation out of the JSON file.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Annotator JSON Export is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
